{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance'' allusions}}

List of references ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' makes to previous ''[[Final Fantasy series|Final Fantasy]]'' titles and other media.

==[[Final Fantasy series|''Final Fantasy'' series]]==
*[[Biggs and Wedge]] appear at the beginning of the game as subordinates of [[Cid Randell]]. Their names can later appear as random units.
*The mission "Falcon Flown" is about a falcon named Hyperion who has gone missing, referring either the recurring [[Hyperion|Chocobo or weapon]].

===''[[Final Fantasy]]''===
*A series of missions where one acquires the sigil [[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance mission items|mission items]] has the players fight monsters named after the [[Four Fiends (Final Fantasy)|Four Fiends]]: [[Lich]], [[Marilith]], [[Kraken]], and [[Tiamat (creature)|Tiamat]]. The sigils themselves are referenced to the four [[Crystal (term)|crystals]].
*The Rat Tail mission item is a reference to the [[Rat Tail (Final Fantasy)|rat's tail]], the item the player gives to [[Bahamut (Final Fantasy)|Bahamut]] to upgrade their [[Job system|jobs]].

===''[[Final Fantasy II]]''===
*The Mindu Gem accessory is a reference to [[Minwu]].
*The Mysidia Alloy and the mission "Mysidia Magic" is a reference to [[Mysidia]], the recurring town of mages.

===''[[Final Fantasy III]]''===
*The Onion Sword is a reference to the [[Onion Knight (job)|Onion Knight]] job, and is said to be order-made for the "legendary Onion Knight".

===''[[Final Fantasy IV]]''===
*An antagonistic clan known as the Red Wings can be fought as a series of side quests in the game. This is a reference to [[Baron]]'s [[Red Wings]] airship force, of which [[Cecil Harvey]] was the commander of.
**Three members of the Red Wings call themselves the [[Magus Sisters]], bosses who originated from ''Final Fantasy IV''.
**Another member named Grissom is also called a [[Dark Knight]]. Although the job is not available in the game, it references how Cecil was a Dark Knight when he lead the Red Wings. 

===''[[Final Fantasy V]]''===
*The missions "Blade & Turtle" and "Armor & Turtle" are posted by a blacksmith named Gilgame. Gilgame was the original translation of the [[Gil Turtle (Final Fantasy V)|Gil Turtle]] in the PlayStation release of ''Final Fantasy V''. 

===''[[Final Fantasy VII]]''===
*The Buster Sword is a reference to the [[Buster sword|iconic sword]] from the game.

===''[[Final Fantasy VIII]]''===
*The Lionheart sword is a reference to [[Squall Leonhart]]'s [[Leonhart|ultimate weapon]].

===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics]]''===
*The Materia Blade is a reference to the blade of the [[Materia Blade|same name]] from ''Tactics'', which in turn is a reference to ''Final Fantasy VII''.
*The Rukavi Soul is a reference to the [[Lucavi]], the main threats of the game, although the name is mistranslated.
*The mission "Secret Books" has an anonymous poster requesting help as they have books proving the Selbaden Church's shady dealings. This may be a reference to the [[Scriptures of Germonique]] and the [[Durai Papers]], which exposed the corruption of the [[Church of Glabados]] in the game.
*There are two references to [[Messam Elmdore]]: in the quest "Karlos' Day", his name is mentioned in the description of the quest in the [[pub]]. There is also an engagement involving a [[Bangaa]] [[Templar (Tactics Advance)|Templar]] named Silverlock.
**In the same engagement, there are two [[Viera]] [[Assassin (Tactics Advance)|Assassins]] named [[Celia]] and [[Lettie|Redy]].
*The Zodiac Ore mission item is a reference to the [[Auracite (Tactics)|Zodiac Stones]].

===''[[Final Fantasy: Unlimited]]''===
*The Calling Gun is a reference to the [[Magun]], and is described as a lost gun of old once used to summon fabulous beasts. 

==Other games==
===''The Legend of Zelda'' series===
*The Master Sword is a reference to the iconic recurring sword from the series.

===''Mortal Kombat'' series===
*The mission "Shadow Clan" is a challenge by the clan's boss, Hanzo. This could be a reference to Scorpion's human form, Hanzo Hasashi, who is the leader of the Shirai Ryu clan of ninjas.
